Questions about Coleshill

What is the doh of Coleshill?

In this version, in A minor, doh is C. If your choir sings it in another key, doh moves to the new key note and every solfa syllable stays the same — that is what movable doh means.

What note does Coleshill start on?

It starts on l, (A in A minor), a pickup before the first full bar. Find doh first, then sing up or down to l,.

What words can be sung to Coleshill?

Coleshill is in the metre 8.6.8.6 — Common Metre (C.M.): lines of 8, 6, 8, 6 syllables. Words written in the same metre fit it, such as Almighty God Your Word Is Cast, Almighty Lord, Before Thy Throne, Hark the Glad Sound; check where the stresses fall before you sing them together.

Is Coleshill in the public domain?

Yes. the tune was first published in 1706. Everyone named died before 1955 and it was published before 1929, so the tune is out of copyright in the UK, the EU, the United States and Nigeria. Modern arrangements of it can still be under copyright.
